items.title: 75234_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: But I mean, Frank and I, we've been friends all since that time.

ctx.x: Well, what kind of Indians were there? There were Choctaws there?
Well, there was Creek, Choctaw, Seminole, whatever branch it was... He knew all the dialects anyway.

So anyway, he came back home, and I guess I was a bad boy, because I didn't really stay home and do like my grandmother wanted me to. But at that time I was more interested in music. So I used to go out on ...(?)... That's how I got to know Frank Wess and Marshall and Ernie Royal.
